citation.authors: Roberts LA, Raastad T, Markworth JF, Figueiredo VC et al

record.population: 21 physically active men (12-week study) and 9 men (muscle biopsy study)
record.design: Randomised comparison of 10 minutes of cold-water immersion against active recovery after strength training
record.finding: Strength and muscle mass increased more with active recovery than with cold-water immersion, and several markers of muscle growth signalling were lower after cold-water immersion.
record.note: Counter-evidence to the recovery claim: relevant if you lift to get bigger or stronger. Men only; ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
